subject: Architecture deep-dive: StellarWave (post-discovery) — scheduling
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@stellarwave.ai>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@stellarwave.ai>
Cc: Sales <sales@stellarwave.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Architecture deep-dive follow-up (post-discovery) — proposed slots

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for the discovery call yesterday — great discussion. As a next step we'd like to run a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive to walk through architecture, integration patterns, and performance expectations for the inference path. That will help us map the right serving configuration (batching, KV caching, quantization profile) for your use case.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 12/01, 10:00–11:15
- Wed 12/02, 14:00–15:15
- Thu 12/03, 08:30–09:45

If none of those work, share a couple of windows that do and we'll adjust. If you want to include any engineers (network/security/infra) on your side, please loop them in — the more granular the questions, the better.

Attached: post-discovery-notes.pdf (brief recap).

Proposed agenda (high level):
- 10 min: goals & production constraints
- 25 min: current architecture / integration points
- 20 min: Redwood runtime deep-dive (KV cache, batching, routing fallbacks)
- 15 min: Q&A & next steps

Thanks — happy to adapt the agenda.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
(+1) 415-555-0183

Attachment: post-discovery-notes.pdf (application/pdf, 45KB)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@stellarwave.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Architecture deep-dive follow-up (post-discovery) — proposed slots

Thanks Mina — appreciate the recap and agenda.

Tue at 10:00 conflicts with our sprint planning and Thu morning is tight. Wed 12/02 at 14:00 PST should work for us, but can we push to 14:30–15:45 PST instead? That gives Priya (our cloud architect) time to join after an internal call.

Also, could you include a brief list of the specific infra artifacts you want to see (VM specs, network egress, firewall rules, expected token sizes) so we can have those on hand? Priya will join and she'd like to know whether you need detailed diagrams or just high-level pointers.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Turner
Director of Product, StellarWave
alex.turner@stellarwave.ai

Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Architecture deep-dive follow-up (post-discovery) — confirmed time & prep

Perfect — thanks Alex. Wed 12/02 14:30–15:45 PST is confirmed. I'll send a calendar invite and attach a short architecture brief for the session.

Ask from your side: if you can pull basic VM sizes, typical request TTLs, and any current prefix caching you run, that will speed us up. No need for documents we can't share — screenshots or bullet points are fine.

Attached: redwood-arch-brief.pdf (high-level slide deck), prep-agenda.md (internal prep notes).

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765

I'll cover runtime behaviors (batching, kv cache pruning, fallback routing) and loop Sean in for operational SLAs. Neha will lead the section on integration patterns.

Looking forward to it — see you on Wed.

Best,
Mina

Attachment: redwood-arch-brief.pdf (application/pdf, 720KB)
Attachment: prep-agenda.md (text/markdown, 6KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 15:00:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: prep notes for StellarWave deep-dive (Wed 12/02)

Sean / Neha — quick prep items ahead of Wed: could you review the attached prep-agenda.md and note ownership for the following bullets?
- Sean: SLA/operational fallback behavior + redwood dedicated vs hosted fallbacks
- Neha: integration patterns (prefix caching, auth flow, KV lifecycle) + sample request/response size ranges

Also, we should be ready with one short demo of a prefix-KV cache hit vs miss to show cost delta. Keep it to ~5 minutes.

I'll handle runtime kernels and batching heuristics. We've got acceptance from Alex to include their infra lead if needed.

Thanks — ping me if you want anything added to the slides.

Mina

Attachment: prep-agenda.md

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@stellarwave.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@stellarwave.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Architecture deep-dive follow-up (post-discovery) — confirmed time & prep

Confirmed for Wed 12/02 14:30–15:45 PST. Priya will join and I may bring Raj (our infra lead) for the networking bits. We'll compile the VM sizes and token samples and upload to the shared folder before the call.

I've attached a short list of initial questions so we can keep the session focused: stellarwave-arch-questions.docx.

Thanks all, looking forward to it.

— Alex
